phase_prompt.summary: Dormant Ankh‑Infused Reactor with faint glow.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A dormant Ankh‑Infused Reactor, 10 meters tall, made of weathered basalt and copper, encased in a subtle crystalline lattice. The central ankh‑shaped core emits a faint, steady glow, while glyphic panels glow dimly. The structure hums softly, its surface weathered but alive with latent power, rendered in photorealistic detail with tactile textures and a serious cinematic tone.
